sentences.text: Caton Frates became Senior Executive Vice President, Chief Operating Officer - Warehouse Operations, U.S. and Mexico in February 2026, succeeding Russ D. Miller, whose retirement was announced on August 4, 2025, while Executive Vice President Jim C. Klauer is retiring effective October 30, 2026; Ron M. Vachris remains President and CEO and Gary Millerchip Executive Vice President and CFO.

sentences.quote: President and CEO Ron Vachris said that Costco opened 25 net new warehouses in fiscal 2026, bringing the worldwide total to 939. Management plans 33 openings in fiscal 2027, including five relocations, as it works toward 30 net new warehouses annually.
sentences.text: On the fiscal 2026 fourth-quarter call Vachris said Costco opened 25 net new warehouses, reaching 939, and plans 33 openings in fiscal 2027 while targeting 30 net new annually, backed by about $7.5 billion of fiscal 2027 capital expenditure.

sentences.quote: The company implemented price reductions on several Kirkland Signature staples, including walnuts, coffee, and black pepper, to reinvest a portion of $184 million in tariff refunds.
sentences.text: Management cut prices on Kirkland Signature staples to reinvest part of $184 million in tariff refunds.
